newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING's nine-month net profit up 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: ING's nine-month net profit up 24 percent.

text.p: Dutch banking and insurance group ING Groep NV said Thursday its nine-month net profits rose by 24 percent to 2.34 billion guilders ($1.4 billion).
The results, up from 1.88 billion guilders ($1.12 billion) a year ago, were about in the middle of analysts' expectations.

Pre-tax banking and insurance profits both showed strong increases, with insurance profits growing to 1.72 billion guilders ($1.02 billion) and banking profits rising to 1.62 billion guilders ($964 million).
